_note: Generated by scripts/derive-cause-lists.js from 4 daily cause lists in data/cause-lists/. Regenerate rather than editing — it is rebuilt from the .jsonl files every run.
_review: window: 5386 resolved appearances from 4 sitting days (2026-08-22 to 2026-08-25), across 4 daily files.
unresolved: 933 appearances named someone not matched to a person in data/ — usually an AoR firm, which files under the firm's name rather than an individual's. They are counted in nothing below.
ambiguous names: 200 appearances matched more than one person on the roll and were left unassigned rather than guessed.

frequency thresholds: "primary" at 20+ listings in the window, "regular" at 5+, otherwise "occasional". Over a short window almost everyone is occasional; the labels only mean something once months of lists have accumulated.

edge thresholds: co_counsel_with needs 3+ shared matters, opposed needs 4+. 9752 same-side pairs and 609 opposing pairs fell below that and were dropped — with more days accumulated they will cross it.

what an appearance is not: Being on a cause list means being on record for a party that day. It does not mean the matter was reached, or that this person argued it. No seniority or mentorship is inferred from any edge here.
